data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in Report 1 (qwen3-235b): the LLM API request failed with HTTP 400 BadRequestError when reviewing the PKGBUILD, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to complete PKGBUILD review due to LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: When a full file review fails with an API error but an initial audit of the same file succeeded, the tool should preserve and use the initial audit results rather than marking the file as inconclusive
Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from genuine content uncertainty - a failed review is a coverage gap, not evidence of risk
Initial PKGBUILD audits that succeed should be retained as evidence even if subsequent full reviews fail
